translations.idiomatic: Order prefectures, departments, and counties according to registered domicile and name to conscript and deliver to the guard—then the abuse of dispatching personnel causing harassment will of itself cease.

sentences.zh: 其五曰洪武中令軍士七分屯田，三分守城，最為善策。

translations.literal: The fifth says in Hongwu it was ordered that soldiers seven parts garrison-farm, three parts guard the city—the most excellent policy.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth says in the Hongwu era it was ordered that soldiers seven parts garrison-farm, three parts guard the city—the most excellent policy.

sentences.zh: 比者調度日繁，興造日廣，虛有屯種之名，田多荒蕪。

translations.literal: Recently transfers and deployments have grown frequent, construction daily expands—there is only the name of garrison planting, while fields are mostly abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Recently transfers and deployments have grown frequent, construction daily expands—there is only the name of garrison planting, while fields are mostly abandoned.

sentences.zh: 兼養馬、采草、伐薪、燒炭，雜役旁午，兵力焉得不疲、農業焉得不廢？

translations.literal: Added to raising horses, gathering fodder, cutting firewood, burning charcoal—miscellaneous corvée duties at every turn—how can military strength not be exhausted, how can agriculture not be abandoned?
translations.idiomatic: Added to raising horses, gathering fodder, cutting firewood, burning charcoal—miscellaneous corvée duties at every turn—how can military strength not be exhausted, how can agriculture not be abandoned?

sentences.zh: 願敕邊將課卒墾荒，限以頃畝，官給牛種，稽其勤惰，明賞罰以示勸懲。

translations.literal: I wish the frontier generals be ordered to compel troops to reclaim wasteland, limit by qing and mu, the state provide oxen and seed, examine their diligence and slackness, clearly display rewards and punishments to show encouragement and warning.
translations.idiomatic: I wish the frontier generals be ordered to compel troops to reclaim wasteland, limit by qing and mu, the state provide oxen and seed, examine their diligence and slackness, and clearly display rewards and punishments to show encouragement and warning.

sentences.zh: 則塞下田可盡墾，轉餉益紓，諸邊富實，計無便於此者。

translations.literal: Then frontier fields can be fully reclaimed, transport of grain will be further eased, the various frontiers rich and solid—no plan is more convenient than this.
translations.idiomatic: Then frontier fields can be fully reclaimed, transport of grain will be further eased, the various frontiers rich and solid—no plan is more convenient than this.

sentences.zh: 其六曰，學校者，風化之源，人材所自出，貴明體適用，非徒較文藝而已也。

translations.literal: The sixth says schools are the source of moral transformation, where talent issues forth—it is prized to clarify substance and fit for application, not merely to compare literary accomplishments.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth says schools are the source of moral transformation, where talent issues forth—it is prized to clarify substance and fit for application, not merely to compare literary accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 洪武中妙選師儒，教養甚備，人材彬彬可觀。

translations.literal: In Hongwu teachers and scholars were wondrously selected, nurturing and training very complete—talent flourished and was splendid to behold.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongwu era teachers and scholars were wondrously selected, nurturing and training very complete—talent flourished and was splendid to behold.

sentences.zh: 邇來士習委靡，立志不弘，執節不固。

translations.literal: Recently scholars' habits have declined, aspirations not broad, integrity of conduct not firm.
translations.idiomatic: Recently scholars' habits have declined, aspirations not broad, integrity of conduct not firm.

sentences.zh: 平居無剛方正大之氣，安望其立朝為名公卿哉！

translations.literal: In ordinary life without stern, upright, and grand spirit—how can one look to them to stand at court as eminent ministers and grand counsellors!
translations.idiomatic: In ordinary life without stern, upright, and grand spirit—how can one look to them to stand at court as eminent ministers and grand counsellors!

sentences.zh: 宜選良士為郡縣學官，擇民間子弟性行端謹者為生徒，訓以經史，勉以節行。

translations.literal: It is fit to select worthy scholars as prefectural and county school officers, select among the common people's sons those upright and careful in character as students, instruct them in the Classics and histories, exhort them in integrity of conduct.
translations.idiomatic: It is fit to select worthy scholars as prefectural and county school officers, select among the common people's sons those upright and careful in character as students, instruct them in the Classics and histories, and exhort them in integrity of conduct.

sentences.zh: 俟其有成，貢於國學。

translations.literal: Wait until they have achievement, then tribute them to the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Wait until they have achieved mastery, then present them to the National University.

sentences.zh: 磨礱砥礪，使其氣充誌定，卓然成材，然後舉而用之，以任天下國家事無難矣。

translations.literal: Grind and temper them, making their spirit full and resolve set, standing out as accomplished talent—then raise and employ them; to entrust them with affairs of the realm under Heaven and the state would be without difficulty.
translations.idiomatic: Grind and temper them, making their spirit full and resolve set, standing out as accomplished talent—then raise and employ them; to entrust them with affairs of the realm under Heaven and the state would be without difficulty.

sentences.zh: 其七曰兵者凶器，聖人不得已而用之。

translations.literal: The seventh says arms are inauspicious instruments—the sage uses them only when unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh says arms are inauspicious instruments—the sage uses them only when unavoidable.

sentences.zh: 漢高祖解平城之圍，未聞蕭、曹勸以復仇；

translations.literal: Han Gaozu resolved the siege at Pingcheng—one did not hear Xiao He and Cao Can urge revenge;
translations.idiomatic: Han Gaozu resolved the siege at Pingcheng—one did not hear Xiao He and Cao Can urge revenge;

sentences.zh: 唐太宗禦突厥於便橋，未聞房、杜勸以報怨。

translations.literal: Tang Taizong repelled the Turks at Bianqiao—one did not hear Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui urge repaying grudges.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Taizong repelled the Turks at Bianqiao—one did not hear Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui urge repaying grudges.

sentences.zh: 古英君良相不欲疲民力以誇武功，計慮遠矣。

translations.literal: Ancient worthy rulers and good ministers did not wish to exhaust the people's strength to boast military achievements—their calculation and consideration were far-reaching indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient worthy rulers and good ministers did not wish to exhaust the people's strength to boast military achievements—their calculation and consideration were far-reaching indeed.

sentences.zh: 洪武初年嘗赫然命將，欲清沙漠。

translations.literal: In the early Hongwu era they once majestically ordered generals, wishing to clear the desert wastes.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Hongwu era they once majestically ordered generals, wishing to clear the desert wastes.

sentences.zh: 既以饋運不繼，旋即頒師。

translations.literal: Since supply transport could not continue, they immediately withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Since supply transport could not continue, they immediately withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 遂撤東勝衛於大同，塞山西陽武谷口，選將練兵，扼險以待。

translations.literal: They then withdrew the Dongsheng Guard to Datong, blocked the Yangwu Pass in Shanxi, selected generals and trained troops, and held perilous passes to await.
translations.idiomatic: They then withdrew the Dongsheng Guard to Datong, blocked the Yangwu Pass in Shanxi, selected generals and trained troops, and held perilous passes to await the enemy.

sentences.zh: 內修政教，外嚴邊備，廣屯田，興學校，罪貪吏，徙頑民。

translations.literal: Internally they cultivated government and education, externally they tightened frontier defenses, broadly expanded garrison farming, established schools, punished greedy officials, and relocated obstinate commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Internally they cultivated government and education, externally they tightened frontier defenses, broadly expanded garrison farming, established schools, punished greedy officials, and relocated obstinate commoners.

sentences.zh: 不數年間，朵兒只巴獻女，伯顏帖木兒、乃兒不花等相繼擒獲，納哈出亦降。

translations.literal: Within a few years Duoyinashiba presented his daughter, Boyan Temür, Naibuhua, and others were captured in succession, and Nahachu also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years Duoyinashiba presented his daughter, Boyan Temür, Naibuhua, and others were captured in succession, and Nahachu also surrendered.

sentences.zh: 此專務內治，不勤遠略之明效也。

translations.literal: This is the clear effect of devoting oneself to internal governance and not zealously pursuing distant strategies.
translations.idiomatic: This is the clear effect of devoting oneself to internal governance and not zealously pursuing distant strategies.

sentences.zh: 伏望遠鑒漢、唐，近法太祖，毋以窮兵黷武為快，毋以犁庭掃穴為功。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will take Han and Tang as distant mirrors and the Taizu Emperor as the near model—do not take exhausting the army and abusing military force as pleasure, do not take uprooting the enemy's nest and sweeping their lair as achievement.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope Your Majesty will take Han and Tang as distant mirrors and Emperor Hongwu as the near model—do not take exhausting the army and abusing military force as pleasure, do not take uprooting the enemy's nest and sweeping their lair as achievement.

sentences.zh: 棄捐不毛之地，休養冠帶之民，俾竭力於田桑，盡心於庠序。

translations.literal: Abandon barren lands, rest and nurture the civilized people, make them exert their strength in fields and mulberry, devote their hearts to schools.
translations.idiomatic: Abandon barren lands, rest and nurture the civilized people, make them exert their strength in fields and mulberry, and devote their hearts to schools.

sentences.zh: 邊塞絕傷痍之苦，閭里絕呻吟之聲。

translations.literal: The frontier passes will be free of the suffering of wounds, the villages free of the sounds of groaning.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier passes will be free of the suffering of wounds, and the villages free of the sounds of groaning.

sentences.zh: 將無幸功，士無夭閼，遠人自服，荒外自歸。

translations.literal: Generals will not hope for lucky achievements, scholars will not die young and frustrated, distant peoples will of themselves submit, the wild beyond will of themselves return.
translations.idiomatic: Generals will not hope for lucky achievements, scholars will not die young and frustrated, distant peoples will of themselves submit, and the wild beyond will of themselves return.

sentences.zh: 國祚靈長於萬年矣。

translations.literal: The dynastic fortune will be numinously enduring for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: The dynastic fortune will be numinously enduring for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 其八曰官不在眾，在乎得人。

translations.literal: The eighth says officials are not in multitude but in obtaining the right persons.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth says officials are not in multitude but in obtaining the right persons.

sentences.zh: 國家承大亂後，因時損益，以府為州，以州為縣。

translations.literal: The state, inheriting after great disorder, increased and decreased according to the times—making prefectures into departments, departments into counties.
translations.idiomatic: The state, inheriting after great disorder, increased and decreased according to the times—making prefectures into departments, departments into counties.

sentences.zh: 繼又裁並小縣之糧不及俸者，量民數以設官。

translations.literal: Subsequently they also cut and merged small counties whose grain revenue did not reach official salaries, measuring population numbers to establish officials.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently they also cut and merged small counties whose grain revenue did not reach official salaries, measuring population numbers to establish officials.

sentences.zh: 民多者縣設丞薄，少者知縣、典史而已。

translations.literal: Where population was large the county had assistant magistrate and registrar; where small, only the magistrate and archivist.
translations.idiomatic: Where population was large the county had assistant magistrate and registrar; where small, only the magistrate and archivist.

sentences.zh: 其時官無廢事，民不愁勞。

translations.literal: At that time officials had no neglected affairs, the people did not worry over toil.
translations.idiomatic: At that time officials had no neglected affairs, and the people did not worry over toil.

sentences.zh: 今藩、臬二司及府、州、縣官，視洪武中再倍，政愈不理，民愈不寧，奸弊叢生，詐偽滋起。

translations.literal: Today the two provincial commissions and prefectural, departmental, and county officials are twice those of the Hongwu era—government grows more ungoverned, the people more unsettled, abuses cluster and multiply, fraud and falsehood flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Today the two provincial commissions and prefectural, departmental, and county officials are twice those of the Hongwu era—government grows more ungoverned, the people more unsettled, abuses cluster and multiply, and fraud and falsehood flourish.

sentences.zh: 甚有官不能聽斷，吏不諳文移，乃容留書寫之人，在官影射，賄賂公行，獄訟淹滯，皆官冗吏濫所致也。

translations.literal: Some officials cannot even hear and decide cases, clerks do not understand documents—yet they retain copyists who act in the officials' shadow at court, bribery runs openly, lawsuits stagnate—all caused by redundant officials and excessive clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Some officials cannot even hear and decide cases, clerks do not understand documents—yet they retain copyists who act in the officials' shadow at court, bribery runs openly, lawsuits stagnate—all caused by redundant officials and excessive clerks.

sentences.zh: 望斷自宸衷，凡內外官吏，並依洪武中員額，冗濫者悉汰，則天工無曠，庶績咸熙，而天下大治矣。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will decide from the imperial heart: all internal and external officials alike should follow the Hongwu establishment quotas, and all redundant and excessive ones be eliminated—then no heavenly task will be vacant, all achievements will flourish, and the realm under Heaven will be greatly governed.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will decide from the imperial heart: all internal and external officials alike should follow the Hongwu establishment quotas, and all redundant and excessive ones be eliminated—then no heavenly task will be vacant, all achievements will flourish, and the realm under Heaven will be greatly governed.

sentences.zh: 奏上，命廷臣議之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor ordered court ministers to deliberate on it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor ordered court ministers to deliberate on it.

sentences.zh: 尚書呂震以為文辭冗長，且事多已行，不足采。

translations.literal: Minister Lü Zhen considered the language verbose and lengthy, and moreover many matters had already been implemented—not worth adopting.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Lü Zhen considered the language verbose and lengthy, and moreover many matters had already been implemented—not worth adopting.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「所言甚有學識，多契朕心，當察其素履以聞。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "What was said has great learning and knowledge, much accord with my heart—I should investigate his past conduct and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "What was said has great learning and knowledge, much accord with my heart—I should investigate his past conduct and report.

sentences.zh: 」震乃言：「濟故元進士，曾守郡，坐事戍邊。

translations.literal: " Zhen then said: "Ji is a former Yuan jinshi, once governed a prefecture, implicated in a case and banished to garrison the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhen then said: "Ji is a former Yuan jinshi, once governed a prefecture, implicated in a case and banished to garrison the frontier.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「惜哉斯人！

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "What a pity, this man!
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "What a pity, this man!

sentences.zh: 令久淹行伍，今猶足用。

translations.literal: Having long been submerged in the ranks, he is still usable today.
translations.idiomatic: Having long been submerged in the ranks, he is still usable today.

sentences.zh: 」震曰：「年老矣。

translations.literal: " Zhen said: "He is old.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhen said: "He is old.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「國家用人，正須老成，但不宜任以繁劇。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "The state in employing men just needs seasoned experience—only he should not be assigned heavy and complex duties.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said: "The state in employing men just needs seasoned experience—only he should not be assigned heavy and complex duties.

sentences.zh: 」乃以濟為儒學訓導。

translations.literal: " Ji was then appointed Confucian Instructor.
translations.idiomatic: " Ji was then appointed Confucian Instructor.

sentences.zh: 邇歲土木繁興，異端盛起，番僧絡驛，汙吏縱橫，相臣不正其非，御史不劾其罪，上下蒙蔽，民生雕瘵。

translations.literal: In recent years civil engineering has flourished, heterodox teachings have risen in force, foreign monks fill the post stations, corrupt officials run rampant, chief ministers do not correct their wrongs, censors do not impeach their crimes—above and below conceal one another, the people's livelihood is wasted and afflicted.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years civil engineering has flourished, heterodox teachings have risen in force, foreign monks fill the post stations, corrupt officials run rampant, chief ministers do not correct their wrongs, censors do not impeach their crimes—above and below conceal one another, and the people's livelihood is wasted and afflicted.

sentences.zh: 狡寇犯邊，上皇播越。

translations.literal: Crafty bandits violated the frontier; the Retired Emperor was driven into exile.
translations.idiomatic: Crafty bandits violated the frontier; the Retired Emperor was driven into exile.

sentences.zh: 陛下枕戈嘗膽之秋，可不拔賢舉能，一新政治乎？

translations.literal: Your Majesty, in this season of sleeping on spears and tasting gall—can you not elevate the worthy and raise the capable, and renew government entirely?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, in this season of sleeping on spears and tasting gall—can you not elevate the worthy and raise the capable, and renew government entirely?

sentences.zh: 昔宗、嶽為將，敵國不敢呼名；

translations.literal: Formerly when Zong and Yue were generals, enemy states did not dare speak their names;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Zong Ze and Yue Fei were generals, enemy states did not dare speak their names;

sentences.zh: 韓、範鎮邊，西賊聞之破膽。

translations.literal: Han and Fan guarded the frontier—western bandits heard of them and their courage broke.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan guarded the frontier—western bandits heard of them and their courage broke.

sentences.zh: 司馬光居相位，強鄰戒勿犯邊。

translations.literal: When Sima Guang held the chancellor's position, powerful neighbors were warned not to violate the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: When Sima Guang held the chancellor's position, powerful neighbors were warned not to violate the frontier.

sentences.zh: 今文武大臣之有威名德望者，宜使典樞要，且延訪智術才能之士，布滿朝廷，則也先必畏服，而上皇可指日還矣。

translations.literal: Today civil and military grand ministers with martial renown and moral prestige should be made to manage vital affairs, and moreover wise and capable men of talent should be sought and spread throughout the court—then Esen will surely fear and submit, and the Retired Emperor can return within days.
translations.idiomatic: Today civil and military grand ministers with martial renown and moral prestige should be made to manage vital affairs, and moreover wise and capable men of talent should be sought and spread throughout the court—then Esen will surely fear and submit, and the Retired Emperor can return within days.

sentences.zh: 大臣，陽也；

translations.literal: Grand ministers are yang;
translations.idiomatic: Grand ministers are yang;

sentences.zh: 宦寺，陰也。

translations.literal: palace eunuchs are yin.
translations.idiomatic: palace eunuchs are yin.

sentences.zh: 君子，陽也；

translations.literal: The noble man is yang;
translations.idiomatic: The noble man is yang;

sentences.zh: 小人，陰也。

translations.literal: the petty man is yin.
translations.idiomatic: the petty man is yin.

sentences.zh: 近日食地震，陰盛陽微，謫見天地。

translations.literal: Recently there were eclipses and earthquakes—yin flourishes and yang is weak; reproof appears from Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Recently there were eclipses and earthquakes—yin flourishes and yang is weak; reproof appears from Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 望陛下總攬乾綱，抑宦寺使不得預政，遏小人俾不得居位，則陰陽順而天變弭矣。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will gather the heavenly reins, suppress palace eunuchs so they may not participate in government, restrain petty men so they may not hold office—then yin and yang will be harmonious and heavenly portents will cease.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will gather the heavenly reins, suppress palace eunuchs so they may not participate in government, restrain petty men so they may not hold office—then yin and yang will be harmonious and heavenly portents will cease.

sentences.zh: 天下治亂，在君心邪正。

translations.literal: Order and disorder under Heaven lie in whether the ruler's heart is perverse or upright.
translations.idiomatic: Order and disorder under Heaven lie in whether the ruler's heart is perverse or upright.

sentences.zh: 田獵是娛，宮室是侈，宦寺是狎，三者有一，足蠱君心。

translations.literal: Field hunting as amusement, palaces as extravagance, palace eunuchs as intimacy—if any one of the three exists, it suffices to bewitch the ruler's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Field hunting as amusement, palaces as extravagance, palace eunuchs as intimacy—if any one of the three exists, it suffices to bewitch the ruler's heart.

sentences.zh: 願陛下涵養克治，多接賢士大夫，少親宦官宮妾，自能革奢靡，戒遊佚，而心無不正矣。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would cultivate and restrain yourself, receive many worthy scholar-officials, keep close company with eunuchs and palace women less often—then of yourself you can reform extravagance, guard against wandering and idleness, and your heart will be without perversity.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would cultivate and restrain yourself, receive many worthy scholar-officials, and keep close company with eunuchs and palace women less often—then of yourself you can reform extravagance, guard against wandering and idleness, and your heart will be without perversity.

sentences.zh: 堯立謗木，恐人不言，所以聖；

translations.literal: Yao erected a criticism post, fearing that people would not speak—therefore he was sage;
translations.idiomatic: Yao erected a criticism post, fearing that people would not speak—therefore he was sage;

sentences.zh: 秦除謚法，恐人議己，所以亡。

translations.literal: Qin abolished posthumous title law, fearing that people would criticize them—therefore they perished.
translations.idiomatic: Qin abolished posthumous title law, fearing that people would criticize them—therefore they perished.

sentences.zh: 陛下廣從諫之量，旌直言之臣，則國家利弊，閭閻休戚，臣下無所顧忌，而言無不盡矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, broaden the capacity to accept remonstrance, commend ministers who speak directly—then the state's benefits and harms, the neighborhoods' weal and woe, subordinates will have nothing to fear, and speech will be without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, broaden the capacity to accept remonstrance and commend ministers who speak directly—then regarding the state's benefits and harms and the neighborhoods' weal and woe, subordinates will have nothing to fear, and speech will be without reserve.

sentences.zh: 蘇子曰：「平居無犯顏敢諫之臣，則臨難必無仗節死義之士。

translations.literal: Master Su said: "In ordinary times without ministers who risk offending the face and dare remonstrate, then in crisis there will surely be no men who uphold integrity and die for righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Master Su said: "In ordinary times without ministers who risk offending the face and dare remonstrate, then in crisis there will surely be no men who uphold integrity and die for righteousness.

sentences.zh: 」願陛下恒念是言而審察之。

translations.literal: " I wish Your Majesty would constantly keep this saying in mind and examine it carefully.
translations.idiomatic: " I wish Your Majesty would constantly keep this saying in mind and examine it carefully.

sentences.zh: 書奏，帝頗嘉納之。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor greatly praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; the Emperor greatly praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 後四年，讓登進士。

translations.literal: Four years later, Rang passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later, Rang passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 官知縣卒。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate and died.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate and died.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年，監生郭佑亦上書言兵事，略曰：

translations.literal: In Jingtai 2, Supervising Student Guo You also submitted a memorial on military affairs, briefly saying:
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 2, Supervising Student Guo You also submitted a memorial on military affairs, briefly saying:

sentences.zh: 逆寇犯順，上皇蒙塵，此千古非常之變，百世必報之仇也。

translations.literal: Rebellious bandits violated righteousness; the Retired Emperor suffered dust on his robes—this is a change without parallel in a thousand ages, a grudge that must be repaid for a hundred generations.
translations.idiomatic: Rebellious bandits violated righteousness; the Retired Emperor suffered dust on his robes—this is a change without parallel in a thousand ages, a grudge that must be repaid for a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 今使臣之來，動以數千，務驕蹇責望於我，而我乃隱忍姑息，致賊勢日張，我氣日索，求和與和，求戰與戰，是和戰之權，不在我而在賊也。

translations.literal: Today when their envoys come, they number in the thousands, striving to be arrogant and demanding toward us—yet we forbear and indulge, causing the bandits' power to grow daily and our spirit to shrink daily; we seek peace and they grant peace, we seek war and they grant war—the power over peace and war is not in our hands but in the bandits'.
translations.idiomatic: Today when their envoys come, they number in the thousands, striving to be arrogant and demanding toward us—yet we forbear and indulge, causing the bandits' power to grow daily and our spirit to shrink daily; we seek peace and they grant peace, we seek war and they grant war—the power over peace and war is not in our hands but in the bandits'.

sentences.zh: 願陛下結人心，親賢良，以固國本，廣儲蓄，練將士，以壯國氣。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would unite people's hearts, draw close to the worthy and good to solidify the state's foundation, broadly store up reserves and train generals and troops to strengthen the state's spirit.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would unite people's hearts, draw close to the worthy and good to solidify the state's foundation, broadly store up reserves and train generals and troops to strengthen the state's spirit.

sentences.zh: 正分定名，裁之以義。

translations.literal: Correctly fix roles and establish names, cut them with righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Correctly fix roles and establish names, and cut them with righteousness.

sentences.zh: 如桀驁侵軼，則提兵問罪。

translations.literal: If they are arrogant and overbearing in violation, then raise troops to demand punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If they are arrogant and overbearing in violation, then raise troops to demand punishment.

sentences.zh: 使大漠之南，不敢有匹馬闌入，乃可保百年無虞。

translations.literal: Make it so south of the great desert not a single horse dares stray across the border—then one can preserve a century without worry.
translations.idiomatic: Make it so south of the great desert not a single horse dares stray across the border—then one can preserve a century without worry.

sentences.zh: 不然西北力罷，東南財竭，不能一日安枕矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise the northwest's strength will be exhausted, the southeast's wealth depleted—you cannot rest your head on a pillow for a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise the northwest's strength will be exhausted, the southeast's wealth depleted—you cannot rest your head on a pillow for a single day.

sentences.zh: 昨以國用耗乏，謀國大臣欲紓一時之急，令民納粟者賜冠帶。

translations.literal: Yesterday because state revenue was depleted and exhausted, state-counseling grand ministers wishing to relieve a moment's urgency ordered that those who contributed grain be granted cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Recently because state revenue was depleted and exhausted, state-counseling grand ministers wishing to relieve a moment's urgency ordered that those who contributed grain be granted cap and belt.

sentences.zh: 今軍旅稍寧，行之如故。

translations.literal: Now that the army is somewhat settled, it continues as before.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the army is somewhat settled, it continues as before.

sentences.zh: 農工商販之徒，不較賢愚，惟財是授。

translations.literal: Farmers, craftsmen, merchants, and peddlers—without comparing worthiness and foolishness, only wealth is granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers, craftsmen, merchants, and peddlers—without comparing worthiness and foolishness, only wealth is granted office.

sentences.zh: 驕親戚，誇鄉里，長非分之邪心。

translations.literal: They pride themselves before kin, boast in their villages, and nurture improper perverse hearts.
translations.idiomatic: They pride themselves before kin, boast in their villages, and nurture improper perverse hearts.

sentences.zh: 贓汙吏罷退為民，欲掩閭黨之恥，納粟納草，冠帶而歸。

translations.literal: Corrupt officials dismissed and returned to commoner status, wishing to cover the shame of their neighborhood and clan, contribute grain and fodder, and return with cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Corrupt officials dismissed and returned to commoner status, wishing to cover the shame of their neighborhood and clan, contribute grain and fodder, and return with cap and belt.

sentences.zh: 前以冒貨去職，今以輸貨得官，何以禁貪殘、重名爵？

translations.literal: Previously removed from office for coveting goods, now obtaining office for delivering goods—how can one prohibit greed and cruelty and esteem noble titles?
translations.idiomatic: Previously removed from office for coveting goods, now obtaining office for delivering goods—how can one prohibit greed and cruelty and esteem noble titles?

sentences.zh: 況天下統一，藏富在民，未至大不得已，而舉措如此，是以空乏啟寇心也。

translations.literal: Moreover the realm under Heaven is unified, wealth stored lies with the people—it has not reached great unavoidable necessity, yet measures are such as this—it is using emptiness and exhaustion to open the bandits' hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the realm under Heaven is unified, wealth stored lies with the people—it has not reached great unavoidable necessity, yet measures are such as this—it is using emptiness and exhaustion to open the bandits' hearts.

sentences.zh: 章下廷議，格不行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down for court deliberation; it was blocked and not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down for court deliberation; it was blocked and not implemented.

sentences.zh: 又有胡仲倫者，雲南鹽課提舉司吏目也。

translations.literal: There was also Hu Zhonglun, a clerk of the Yunnan Salt Tax Intendant's Office.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Hu Zhonglun, a clerk of the Yunnan Salt Tax Intendant's Office.

sentences.zh: 緣事入都，會上皇北狩，也先欲妻以妹，上皇因遣廣寧伯劉安入言於帝。

translations.literal: Because of business he entered the capital; it happened that the Retired Emperor went north on hunt, Esen wished to marry him to his younger sister—the Retired Emperor therefore sent Guangning Earl Liu An to enter and speak to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Because of business he entered the capital; it happened that the Retired Emperor went north on hunt, Esen wished to marry him to his younger sister—the Retired Emperor therefore sent Guangning Earl Liu An to enter and speak to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 仲倫上疏爭之，言：「今日事不可屈者有七。

translations.literal: Zhonglun submitted a memorial disputing it, saying: "In today's affair there are seven matters on which one cannot yield.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglun submitted a memorial disputing it, saying: "In today's affair there are seven matters on which one cannot yield.

sentences.zh: 降萬乘之尊，與諧婚媾，一也。

translations.literal: Lowering the dignity of the Son of Heaven to harmonize in marriage alliance—first.
translations.idiomatic: Lowering the dignity of the Son of Heaven to harmonize in marriage alliance—first.

sentences.zh: 敵假和議，使我無備，二也。

translations.literal: The enemy feigns peace talks, making us unprepared—second.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy feigns peace talks, making us unprepared—second.

sentences.zh: 必欲為姻，驕尊自大，三也。

translations.literal: Insisting on marriage, arrogant and self-important—third.
translations.idiomatic: Insisting on marriage, arrogant and self-important—third.

sentences.zh: 索金帛，使我坐困，四也。

translations.literal: Demanding gold and silk, making us sit in exhaustion—fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Demanding gold and silk, making us sit in exhaustion—fourth.

sentences.zh: 以送駕為名，乘機入犯，五也。

translations.literal: Under the name of escorting the Emperor, seizing the opportunity to invade—fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Under the name of escorting the Emperor, seizing the opportunity to invade—fifth.

sentences.zh: 逼上皇手詔，誘取邊城，六也。

translations.literal: Compelling the Retired Emperor's hand-written edict, luring away frontier cities—sixth.
translations.idiomatic: Compelling the Retired Emperor's hand-written edict, luring away frontier cities—sixth.

sentences.zh: 欲求山後之地，七也。

translations.literal: Seeking the lands behind the mountains—seventh.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking the lands behind the mountains—seventh.

sentences.zh: 稍從其一，大事去矣。

translations.literal: Yield even slightly to one of them, and the great affair is lost.
translations.idiomatic: Yield even slightly to one of them, and the great affair is lost.

sentences.zh: 曩上皇在位，王振專權。

translations.literal: Formerly when the Retired Emperor was on the throne, Wang Zhen monopolized power.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when the Retired Emperor was on the throne, Wang Zhen monopolized power.

sentences.zh: 忠諫者死，鯁直者戍；

translations.literal: Those who loyally remonstrated died, the blunt and upright were banished to garrison;
translations.idiomatic: Those who loyally remonstrated died, the blunt and upright were banished to garrison;

sentences.zh: 君子見斥，小人驟遷。

translations.literal: noble men were expelled, petty men were suddenly promoted.
translations.idiomatic: noble men were expelled, petty men were suddenly promoted.

sentences.zh: 章奏多決中旨，黑白混淆，邪正倒置。

translations.literal: Memorials were mostly decided by secret imperial will—black and white confused, perverse and upright inverted.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials were mostly decided by secret imperial will—black and white confused, perverse and upright inverted.

sentences.zh: 閩、浙之寇方殷，瓦剌之釁大作。

translations.literal: Bandits in Fujian and Zhejiang were just rampant; the Oirat provocation greatly erupted.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Fujian and Zhejiang were just rampant; the Oirat provocation greatly erupted.

sentences.zh: 陛下宜親賢遠奸，信賞必罰，通上情，達下誌。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should draw close to the worthy and keep distant from the wicked, trust rewards and surely punish, connect upper sentiments and reach lower wills.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should draw close to the worthy and keep distant from the wicked, trust rewards and surely punish, connect upper sentiments and reach lower wills.

sentences.zh: 賣國之奸無所投隙，倉卒之變末由發機，朝廷自此尊，天下自此安矣。

translations.literal: Traitors who sell the state will have nowhere to slip in, sudden crises will have no means to arise—the court from this will be honored, the realm under Heaven from this will be secure.
translations.idiomatic: Traitors who sell the state will have nowhere to slip in, sudden crises will have no means to arise—the court from this will be honored, and the realm under Heaven from this will be secure.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納焉。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 又有華敏者，南京錦衣軍余也。

translations.literal: There was also Hua Min, a surplus soldier of the Nanjing Embroidered Uniform Guard.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Hua Min, a surplus soldier of the Nanjing Embroidered Uniform Guard.

sentences.zh: 意氣慷慨，讀書通大義，憤王振亂國，與儕輩言輒裂眥怒詈。

translations.literal: His spirit was bold and generous; in reading he understood great principles—indignant that Wang Zhen disturbed the state, when speaking with his peers he would split his eyes in anger and curse.
translations.idiomatic: His spirit was bold and generous; in reading he understood great principles—indignant that Wang Zhen disturbed the state, when speaking with his peers he would split his eyes in anger and curse.

sentences.zh: 景泰三年九月上書曰：

translations.literal: In the ninth month of Jingtai 3 he submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Jingtai 3 he submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 近年以來，內官袁琦、唐受、喜寧、王振專權害政，致國事傾危。

translations.literal: In recent years palace eunuchs Yuan Qi, Tang Shou, Xining, and Wang Zhen monopolized power and harmed government, causing state affairs to lean toward peril.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years palace eunuchs Yuan Qi, Tang Shou, Xining, and Wang Zhen monopolized power and harmed government, causing state affairs to lean toward peril.

sentences.zh: 望陛下防微杜漸，總攬權綱，為子孫萬世法。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will guard against the subtle and stop the gradual, gather the reins of power, and be a model for ten thousand generations of descendants.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will guard against the subtle and stop the gradual, gather the reins of power, and be a model for ten thousand generations of descendants.

sentences.zh: 不然恐禍稔蕭墻，曹節、侯覽之害，復見於今日。

translations.literal: Otherwise I fear disaster will ripen within the palace walls—the harm of Cao Jie and Hou Lan will again appear today.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise I fear disaster will ripen within the palace walls—the harm of Cao Jie and Hou Lan will again appear today.

sentences.zh: 臣雖賤陋，不勝痛哭流涕。

translations.literal: Your subject, though base and lowly, cannot bear it and weeps bitterly with streaming tears.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject, though base and lowly, cannot bear it and weeps bitterly with streaming tears.

sentences.zh: 謹以虐軍害民十事，為陛下痛切言之。

translations.literal: I respectfully take ten matters of abusing the army and harming the people and speak of them to Your Majesty with piercing earnestness.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully take ten matters of abusing the army and harming the people and speak of them to Your Majesty with piercing earnestness.

sentences.zh: 內官家積金銀珠玉，累室兼籯，從何而至？

translations.literal: Palace eunuchs' households accumulate gold, silver, pearls, and jade—rooms piled full, boxes overflowing—whence does it come?
translations.idiomatic: Palace eunuchs' households accumulate gold, silver, pearls, and jade—rooms piled full, boxes overflowing—whence does it come?

sentences.zh: 非內盜府藏，則外朘民膏。

translations.literal: If not stealing from the inner treasury stores, then outwardly draining the people's fat.
translations.idiomatic: If not stealing from the inner treasury stores, then outwardly draining the people's fat.

sentences.zh: 害一也。

translations.literal: Harm—first.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—first.

sentences.zh: 怙勢矜寵，占公侯邸舍，興作工役，勞擾軍民。

translations.literal: Relying on power and flaunting favor, occupying the mansions of dukes and marquises, undertaking construction corvée, toiling and harassing army and people.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on power and flaunting favor, occupying the mansions of dukes and marquises, undertaking construction corvée, toiling and harassing army and people.

sentences.zh: 害二也。

translations.literal: Harm—second.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—second.

sentences.zh: 家人外親，皆市井無籍之子，縱橫豪悍，任意作奸，納粟補官，貴賤淆雜。

translations.literal: Household members and external kin are all sons of the marketplace without registration—running rampant bold and fierce, doing evil at will, contributing grain to supplement office—noble and base confused and mixed.
translations.idiomatic: Household members and external kin are all sons of the marketplace without registration—running rampant bold and fierce, doing evil at will, contributing grain to supplement office—noble and base confused and mixed.

sentences.zh: 害三也。

translations.literal: Harm—third.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—third.

sentences.zh: 建造佛寺，耗費不貲，營一己之私，破萬家之產。

translations.literal: Building Buddhist temples, expense beyond reckoning—serving one's private interest, ruining the property of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Building Buddhist temples, expense beyond reckoning—serving one's private interest, ruining the property of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 害四也。

translations.literal: Harm—fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—fourth.

sentences.zh: 廣置田莊，不入賦稅，寄戶郡縣，不受征徭，阡陌連亙，而民無立錐。

translations.literal: Broadly establishing estate fields, not entering tax rolls, registering households in prefectures and counties, not accepting levies and corvée—field paths stretch unbroken, while the people have no place to stand an awl.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly establishing estate fields, not entering tax rolls, registering households in prefectures and counties, not accepting levies and corvée—field paths stretch unbroken, while the people have no place to stand an awl.

sentences.zh: 害五也。

translations.literal: Harm—fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—fifth.

sentences.zh: 家人中鹽，虛占引數，轉而售人，倍支鉅萬，壞國家法，豪奪商利。

translations.literal: Household members obtain salt licenses, falsely occupy quota numbers, then resell to others, profiting tens of thousands in multiples—destroying state law, forcibly seizing merchants' profit.
translations.idiomatic: Household members obtain salt licenses, falsely occupy quota numbers, then resell to others, profiting tens of thousands in multiples—destroying state law, forcibly seizing merchants' profit.

sentences.zh: 害六也。

translations.literal: Harm—sixth.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—sixth.

sentences.zh: 奏求塌房，邀接商旅，倚勢賒買，恃強不償，行賈坐敝，莫敢誰何。

translations.literal: Memorializing to request warehouse sheds, inviting and receiving traveling merchants, relying on power to buy on credit, trusting in force not to repay—traveling peddlers sit ruined, none dare hold them accountable.
translations.idiomatic: Memorializing to request warehouse sheds, inviting and receiving traveling merchants, relying on power to buy on credit, trusting in force not to repay—traveling peddlers sit ruined, none dare hold them accountable.

sentences.zh: 害七也。

translations.literal: Harm—seventh.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—seventh.

sentences.zh: 賣放軍匠，名為伴當，俾辦月錢，致內府監局營作乏人，工役煩重，並力不足。

translations.literal: Selling off military artisans, called companions-in-service, making them provide monthly payments—causing inner-palace supervisory offices to lack workers, labor corvée heavy and troublesome, combined strength insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Selling off military artisans, called companions-in-service, making them provide monthly payments—causing inner-palace supervisory offices to lack workers, labor corvée heavy and troublesome, combined strength insufficient.

sentences.zh: 害八也。

translations.literal: Harm—eighth.
translations.idiomatic: Harm—eighth.

translations.idiomatic: Harm—ninth.

translations.idiomatic: Zuo Ding, styled Zhouqi, came from Yongxin.

translations.idiomatic: The Emperor assented.

translations.idiomatic: Minister Wang Zhi examined Ding together with Bai Gui and more than ten others—understanding penal law—and all were appointed censors.

sentences.zh: 尋改北，巡按山西。

translations.idiomatic: Soon transferred to the north, touring and investigating Shanxi.

translations.idiomatic: At that time Emperor Yingzong went north on hunt; war and famine arrived in succession.

translations.idiomatic: Section chiefs were two per bureau; today some have increased to ten.

translations.idiomatic: Censors were sixty; today there are more than a hundred.

translations.idiomatic: Externally there are added posts of pacifying-the-people and managing-garrison officials.

translations.idiomatic: Make them thoroughly understand government affairs—then they can govern people.

translations.literal: He inspected the salt administration of the Two Huai.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected the salt administration of the Two Huai.

sentences.zh: 駙馬都尉趙輝侵利，劾奏之。

translations.literal: Chief Commandant of the Empress's Horse Zhao Hui encroached on profit; he impeached and memorialized him.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Commandant of the Empress's Horse Zhao Hui encroached on profit; he impeached and memorialized him.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，偕同官應詔陳八事，並允行。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year, together with colleagues he responded to an edict and submitted eight matters—all were approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year, together with colleagues he responded to an edict and submitted eight matters—all were approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 亡何，復偕同官上言：「吏部推選不公，任情高下，請置尚書何文淵、右侍郎項文曜於理。

translations.literal: Before long, again together with colleagues he submitted: "The Ministry of Personnel's selections are unfair, arbitrarily high or low—I ask that Minister He Wenyuan and Right Vice Minister Xiang Wenyao be brought to justice.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, again together with colleagues he submitted: "The Ministry of Personnel's selections are unfair, arbitrarily high or low—I ask that Minister He Wenyuan and Right Vice Minister Xiang Wenyao be brought to justice.

sentences.zh: 尚書王直、左侍郎俞山素行本端，為文曜等所罔，均宜按問。

translations.literal: Minister Wang Zhi and Left Vice Minister Yu Shan's conduct has always been upright, yet they were misled by Wenyao and others—all should be investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wang Zhi and Left Vice Minister Yu Shan's conduct has always been upright, yet they were misled by Wenyao and others—all should be investigated.

sentences.zh: 」帝雖不罪，終以綱等為直。

translations.literal: " Though the Emperor did not punish them, he ultimately considered Gang and others to be upright.
translations.idiomatic: " Though the Emperor did not punish them, he ultimately considered Gang and others to be upright.

sentences.zh: 明年命出贊延綏軍務，自陳名輕責重，乞授僉都御史。

translations.literal: The next year he was ordered out to assist Yan-sui military affairs; he stated himself that his name was light and responsibility heavy, begging appointment as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was ordered out to assist Yan-sui military affairs; he stated himself that his name was light and responsibility heavy, begging appointment as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「遷官可自求耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Can one seek promotion for oneself?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Can one seek promotion for oneself?

sentences.zh: 」遂寢其命。

translations.literal: " His order was thereupon shelved.
translations.idiomatic: " His order was thereupon shelved.

sentences.zh: 初，京師戒嚴，募四方民壯分營訓練，歲久多逃，或赴操不如期，廷議編之尺籍。

translations.literal: Initially when the capital was under martial law, sturdy men from all directions were recruited and divided into camps for training; after years many fled, or failed to report for drill on schedule—the court deliberated registering them in military rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Initially when the capital was under martial law, sturdy men from all directions were recruited and divided into camps for training; after years many fled, or failed to report for drill on schedule—the court deliberated registering them in military rolls.

sentences.zh: 綱等言：「召募之初，激以忠義，許事定罷遣。

translations.literal: Gang and others said: "At the start of recruitment, they were roused with loyalty and righteousness, promised dismissal when affairs were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Gang and others said: "At the start of recruitment, they were roused with loyalty and righteousness, promised dismissal when affairs were settled.

sentences.zh: 今展轉輪操，已孤所望，況其逃亡，實迫寒餒，豈可遽著軍籍。

translations.literal: Today rotating drill in succession has already betrayed their hopes; moreover their flight is truly forced by cold and hunger—how can they suddenly be entered in military registers.
translations.idiomatic: Today rotating drill in succession has already betrayed their hopes; moreover their flight is truly forced by cold and hunger—how can they suddenly be entered in military registers.

sentences.zh: 邊方多故，倘更召募，誰復應之？

translations.literal: The frontier has many troubles—if recruitment is attempted again, who will respond?
translations.idiomatic: The frontier has many troubles—if recruitment is attempted again, who will respond?

sentences.zh: 」詔即除前令。

translations.literal: " An edict immediately abolished the previous order.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict immediately abolished the previous order.

sentences.zh: 五年巡按福建，與按察使楊玨互訐，俱下吏。

translations.literal: In the fifth year touring and investigating Fujian, he and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Jue mutually impeached each other—both were sent to officials for trial.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year touring and investigating Fujian, he and Surveillance Commissioner Yang Jue mutually impeached each other—both were sent to officials for trial.

sentences.zh: 謫玨黃州知府，綱邠州判官。

translations.literal: Jue was demoted to Prefect of Huangzhou; Gang to Assistant Magistrate of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jue was demoted to Prefect of Huangzhou; Gang to Assistant Magistrate of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 久之卒。

translations.literal: After a long time he died.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he died.

sentences.zh: 曹凱，字宗元，益都人。

translations.literal: Cao Kai, styled Zongyuan, came from Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Kai, styled Zongyuan, came from Yidu.

sentences.zh: 正統十年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in Zhengtong 10.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengtong 10.

sentences.zh: 授刑科給事中。

translations.literal: Appointed Supervising Secretary in the Penal Section.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Penal Section.

sentences.zh: 磊落多壯節。

translations.literal: Open and bold, with many stalwart principles.
translations.idiomatic: Open and bold, with many stalwart principles.

sentences.zh: 英宗北征，諫甚力，且曰：「今日之勢，大異澶淵。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yingzong campaigned north, he remonstrated with great force, saying: "Today's situation greatly differs from Chanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yingzong campaigned north, he remonstrated with great force, saying: "Today's situation greatly differs from Chanyuan.

sentences.zh: 彼文武忠勇，士馬勁悍。

translations.literal: There civil and military were loyal and brave, troops and horses strong and fierce.
translations.idiomatic: There civil and military were loyal and brave, troops and horses strong and fierce.

sentences.zh: 今中貴竊權，人心玩愒。

translations.literal: Today palace favorites steal power; people's hearts are lax and weary.
translations.idiomatic: Today palace favorites steal power; people's hearts are lax and weary.

sentences.zh: 此輩不惟以陛下為孤註，即懷、湣、徽、欽亦何暇恤？

translations.literal: These men not only treat Your Majesty as a lone wager—even Emperors Huai, Min, Hui, and Qin, what leisure had they to care?
translations.idiomatic: These men not only treat Your Majesty as a lone wager—even Emperors Huai, Min, Hui, and Qin, what leisure had they to care?

sentences.zh: 」帝不從，乘輿果陷。

translations.literal: " The Emperor did not follow; the imperial carriage indeed fell into peril.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor did not follow; the imperial carriage indeed fell into peril.

sentences.zh: 凱痛哭竟日，聲徹禁庭，與王竑共擊馬順至死。

translations.literal: Kai wept bitterly all day, his voice penetrating the forbidden court; together with Wang Hong he beat Ma Shun to death.
translations.idiomatic: Kai wept bitterly all day, his voice penetrating the forbidden court; together with Wang Hong he beat Ma Shun to death.

sentences.zh: 景泰中，遷左。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai era, transferred to the Left.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingtai era, he was transferred to the Left Section.

sentences.zh: 給事中林聰劾何文淵、周旋，詔宥之。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Lin Cong impeached He Wenyuan and Zhou Xuan; an edict pardoned them.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Lin Cong impeached He Wenyuan and Zhou Xuan; an edict pardoned them.

sentences.zh: 凱上殿力諍，二人遂下吏。

translations.literal: Kai entered the hall and forcefully remonstrated; the two were thereupon sent to officials.
translations.idiomatic: Kai entered the hall and forcefully remonstrated; the two were thereupon sent to officials.

sentences.zh: 時令輸豆得補官，凱爭曰：「近例，輸豆四千石以上，授指揮。

translations.literal: At the time it was ordered that contributing beans could supplement office; Kai disputed, saying: "Recent precedent: contributing four thousand shi of beans or more grants commandership.
translations.idiomatic: At the time it was ordered that contributing beans could supplement office; Kai disputed, saying: "Recent precedent: contributing four thousand shi of beans or more grants commandership.

sentences.zh: 彼受祿十餘年，費已償矣，乃令之世襲，是以生民膏血養無功子孫，而彼取息長無窮也。

translations.literal: They received salary for more than ten years—the cost is already repaid—yet they are allowed hereditary succession; thus the people's fat and blood nourish meritless descendants, while they draw interest endlessly.
translations.idiomatic: They received salary for more than ten years—the cost is already repaid—yet they are allowed hereditary succession; thus the people's fat and blood nourish meritless descendants, while they draw interest endlessly.

sentences.zh: 有功者必相謂曰：吾以捐軀獲此，彼以輸豆亦獲此，是朝廷以我軀命等於荏菽，其誰不解體！

translations.literal: Those with achievement will surely say to each other: I obtained this by giving my body, he obtained this by contributing beans—the court equates my life with beans and millet; who will not lose heart!
translations.idiomatic: Those with achievement will surely say to each other: I obtained this by giving my body, he obtained this by contributing beans—the court equates my life with beans and millet; who will not lose heart!

sentences.zh: 乞自今惟令帶俸，不得任事傳襲，文職則止原籍帶俸。

translations.literal: I beg from now only allow them to draw salary, not hold office or transmit inheritance; for civil posts, only draw salary at original domicile.
translations.idiomatic: I beg from now only allow them to draw salary, not hold office or transmit inheritance; for civil posts, only draw salary at original domicile.

sentences.zh: 」帝以為然，命已授者如故，未授者悉如凱議。

translations.literal: " The Emperor considered it correct, ordering those already granted to remain as before, those not yet granted all according to Kai's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor considered it correct, ordering those already granted to remain as before, those not yet granted all according to Kai's proposal.

sentences.zh: 福建巡按許仕達與侍郎薛希璉相訐，命凱往勘。

translations.literal: Fujian touring investigator Xu Shida and Vice Minister Xue Xilian mutually impeached each other; Kai was ordered to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian touring investigator Xu Shida and Vice Minister Xue Xilian mutually impeached each other; Kai was ordered to go investigate.

sentences.zh: 用薦，擢浙江右參政。

translations.literal: On recommendation, promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On recommendation, he was promoted to Right Administrative Commissioner of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時諸衛武職役軍辦納月錢，至四千五百餘人，以凱言禁止。

translations.literal: At the time military officers of various guards forced soldiers to provide monthly payments—more than four thousand five hundred men—prohibited on Kai's word.
translations.idiomatic: At the time military officers of various guards forced soldiers to provide monthly payments—more than four thousand five hundred men—prohibited on Kai's word.

sentences.zh: 鎮守都督李信擅募民為軍，糜餉萬餘石，凱劾奏之。

translations.literal: Frontier Commander Li Xin arbitrarily recruited commoners as soldiers, wasting more than ten thousand shi of provisions; Kai impeached and memorialized him.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier Commander Li Xin arbitrarily recruited commoners as soldiers, wasting more than ten thousand shi of provisions; Kai impeached and memorialized him.

sentences.zh: 信雖獲宥，諸助信募軍者咸獲罪，在浙數年，聲甚著。

translations.literal: Though Xin obtained pardon, all who helped Xin recruit soldiers were punished; serving in Zhejiang several years, his reputation was very prominent.
translations.idiomatic: Though Xin obtained pardon, all who helped Xin recruit soldiers were punished; serving in Zhejiang several years, his reputation was very prominent.

sentences.zh: 初，凱為給事，常劾武清侯石亨。

translations.literal: Initially when Kai was supervising secretary, he often impeached Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Initially when Kai was supervising secretary, he often impeached Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng.

sentences.zh: 亨得志，修前憾，謫凱衛經歷，卒。

translations.literal: When Heng got his wish, he settled old grudges, demoting Kai to guard intendant—he died.
translations.idiomatic: When Heng got his wish, he settled old grudges, demoting Kai to guard intendant—he died.

sentences.zh: 許仕達，歙人。

translations.literal: Xu Shida came from She.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shida came from She.

sentences.zh: 正統十年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in Zhengtong 10.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengtong 10.

sentences.zh: 擢御史。

translations.literal: Promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年四月上疏言災沴數見，請帝痛自修省。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Jingtai 1 he submitted a memorial saying calamities and portents appeared repeatedly, asking the Emperor to deeply examine and reform himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Jingtai 1 he submitted a memorial saying calamities and portents appeared repeatedly, asking the Emperor to deeply examine and reform himself.

sentences.zh: 帝深納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor deeply accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor deeply accepted it.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復請於經筵之余，日延儒臣講論經史。

translations.literal: Before long, he again asked that beyond the classics lectures, scholar-officials be daily invited to discuss the Classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he again asked that beyond the classics lectures, scholar-officials be daily invited to discuss the Classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 帝亦優詔褒答。

translations.literal: The Emperor also replied with a gracious edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor also replied with a gracious edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 巡按福建，劾鎮守中官廖秀，下之獄。

translations.literal: Touring and investigating Fujian, he impeached the frontier eunuch Liao Xiu and sent him to prison.
translations.idiomatic: Touring and investigating Fujian, he impeached the frontier eunuch Liao Xiu and sent him to prison.

sentences.zh: 秀訐仕達，下鎮守侍郎薛希璉等廉問。

translations.literal: Xiu impeached Shida; frontier Vice Minister Xue Xilian and others were sent to investigate integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu impeached Shida; frontier Vice Minister Xue Xilian and others were sent to investigate integrity.

sentences.zh: 會仕達亦劾希璉貪縱，乃命凱及御史王豪往勘。

translations.literal: It happened that Shida also impeached Xilian for greed and indulgence; Kai and Censor Wang Hao were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Shida also impeached Xilian for greed and indulgence; Kai and Censor Wang Hao were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 還奏，兩人互有虛實。

translations.literal: Returning to report, both men had truth and falsehood in their mutual accusations.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to report, both men had truth and falsehood in their mutual accusations.

sentences.zh: 而耆老數千人乞留仕達，給事中林聰，閩人也，亦為仕達言。

translations.literal: Yet several thousand elders begged to retain Shida; Supervising Secretary Lin Cong, a man of Fujian, also spoke for Shida.
translations.idiomatic: Yet several thousand elders begged to retain Shida; Supervising Secretary Lin Cong, a man of Fujian, also spoke for Shida.

sentences.zh: 乃命留任，且敕希璉勿構郤。

translations.literal: He was ordered to remain in office, and Xilian was admonished not to create enmity.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to remain in office, and Xilian was admonished not to create enmity.

sentences.zh: 仕達厲風紀，執漳州知府馬嗣宗送京師。

translations.literal: Shida enforced discipline, arrested Zhangzhou Prefect Ma Sizong and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shida enforced discipline, arrested Zhangzhou Prefect Ma Sizong and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 大理寺劾其擅執，帝以執贓吏不問。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review impeached him for unauthorized arrest; the Emperor did not inquire because he had arrested a corrupt official.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review impeached him for unauthorized arrest; the Emperor did not inquire because he had arrested a corrupt official.

sentences.zh: 期滿當代，耆老詣闕請留，不許。

translations.literal: When his term expired and replacement was due, elders came to the palace gates begging to retain him—not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired and replacement was due, elders came to the palace gates begging to retain him—not permitted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，即以為福建左參政。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Left Administrative Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Left Administrative Commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 天順中，歷山東、貴州左、右布政使。

translations.literal: In the Tianshun era, he served as Left and Right Provincial Administrator of Shandong and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianshun era, he served as Left and Right Provincial Administrator of Shandong and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 劉煒，字有融，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Liu Wei, styled Yourong, came from Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wei, styled Yourong, came from Cixi.

sentences.zh: 正統四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in Zhengtong 4.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Zhengtong 4.

sentences.zh: 授南京刑科給事中。

translations.literal: Appointed Supervising Secretary in the Penal Section at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Supervising Secretary in the Penal Section at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 副都御史周銓以私憾撻御史。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhou Quan flogged a censor out of private resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhou Quan flogged a censor out of private resentment.

sentences.zh: 諸御史範霖、楊永與尚褫等十人共劾銓，煒與同官盧祥等復劾之。

translations.literal: Censors Fan Lin, Yang Yong, and Shang Chi and nine others jointly impeached Quan; Wei together with colleagues Lu Xiang and others again impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Fan Lin, Yang Yong, and Shang Chi and nine others jointly impeached Quan; Wei together with colleagues Lu Xiang and others again impeached him.

sentences.zh: 銓下詔獄，亦訐霖、永及煒、祥等。

translations.literal: Quan was sent to the imperial prison; he also impeached Lin, Yong, Wei, Xiang, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was sent to the imperial prison; he also impeached Lin, Yong, Wei, Xiang, and others.

sentences.zh: 王振素惡言官，盡逮下詔獄。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen always hated remonstrating officials—all were arrested and sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen always hated remonstrating officials—all were arrested and sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 霖、永坐絞，後減死。

translations.literal: Lin and Yong were sentenced to strangulation, later reduced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Lin and Yong were sentenced to strangulation, later commuted from death.

sentences.zh: 他御史或戍或謫。

translations.literal: Other censors were either banished to garrison or demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Other censors were either banished to garrison or demoted.

sentences.zh: 煒、祥事白留任，而銓已先瘐死。

translations.literal: Wei's and Xiang's cases were cleared and they remained in office, but Quan had already died of illness in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's and Xiang's cases were cleared and they remained in office, but Quan had already died of illness in prison.

sentences.zh: 煒累進都給事中。

translations.literal: Wei was promoted in succession to Chief Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was promoted in succession to Chief Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 景泰四年，戶部以邊儲不足，奏令罷退官非贓罪者，輸米二十石，給之誥敕。

translations.literal: In Jingtai 4, because frontier stores were insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that dismissed officials without corruption charges who contributed twenty shi of rice be granted patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingtai 4, because frontier stores were insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that dismissed officials without corruption charges who contributed twenty shi of rice be granted patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 煒等言：「考退之官，多有罷軟酷虐、荒溺酒色、廉恥不立者，非止贓罪已也。

translations.literal: Wei and others said: "Among dismissed officials, many are weak, cruel, dissolute in wine and women, without established integrity—not only corruption charges.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and others said: "Among dismissed officials, many are weak, cruel, dissolute in wine and women, without established integrity—not only corruption charges.

sentences.zh: 賜之誥敕，以何為辭？

translations.literal: Granting them patents of appointment—with what words?
translations.idiomatic: Granting them patents of appointment—with what words?

sentences.zh: 若但褒其納米，則是朝廷誥敕止直米二十石，何以示天下後世？

translations.literal: If only praising their rice contribution, then the court's patent is worth only twenty shi of rice—how can this be shown to the realm and posterity?
translations.idiomatic: If only praising their rice contribution, then the court's patent is worth only twenty shi of rice—how can this be shown to the realm and posterity?

sentences.zh: 此由尚書金濂不識大體，有此謬舉。

translations.literal: This is because Minister Jin Lian did not understand the larger pattern, making this absurd proposal.
translations.idiomatic: This is because Minister Jin Lian did not understand the larger pattern, making this absurd proposal.

sentences.zh: 」帝立為已之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor immediately stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor immediately stopped it.

sentences.zh: 山東歲歉，戶部以尚書沈翼習其地民瘼，請令往振。

translations.literal: Shandong had a poor harvest; the Ministry of Revenue, because Minister Shen Yi was familiar with the people's afflictions there, asked that he be sent to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had a poor harvest; the Ministry of Revenue, because Minister Shen Yi was familiar with the people's afflictions there, asked that he be sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 及往，初無方略。

translations.literal: When he went, at first he had no strategy.
translations.idiomatic: When he went, at first he had no strategy.

sentences.zh: 煒因劾翼，且言：「其地已有尚書薛希璉、少卿張固鎮撫，又有侍郎鄒幹、都御史王竑振濟，而復益之以冀，所謂『十羊九牧』。

translations.literal: Wei thereupon impeached Yi, saying: "That region already has Minister Xue Xilian and Junior Minister Zhang Gu pacifying, also Vice Minister Zou Gan and Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong providing relief—yet Yi is added again, what is called 'ten sheep, nine shepherds.'
translations.idiomatic: Wei thereupon impeached Yi, saying: "That region already has Minister Xue Xilian and Junior Minister Zhang Gu pacifying, also Vice Minister Zou Gan and Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong providing relief—yet Yi is added again, what is called 'ten sheep, nine shepherds.'

sentences.zh: 乞還冀南京戶部，而專以命希璉等。

translations.literal: I beg return Yi to the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue, and entrust affairs solely to Xilian and others.
translations.idiomatic: I beg return Yi to the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue, and entrust affairs solely to Xilian and others.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " It was followed.

sentences.zh: 平江侯陳豫鎮臨清，事多違制。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Yu commanded at Linqing; many affairs violated regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Yu commanded at Linqing; many affairs violated regulations.

sentences.zh: 煒劾之，豫被責讓。

translations.literal: Wei impeached him; Yu was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Wei impeached him; Yu was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 明年，都督黃竑以易儲議得帝眷，奏求霸州、武清縣地。

translations.literal: The next year, Regional Commander Huang Gong, having gained the Emperor's favor through the heir-change debate, memorialized requesting land in Bazhou and Wuqing counties.
